heading: Rent
text: Rent of $1,210 is due on November 5, 2026.

heading: Deposit
text: Tenant must pay a security deposit of $800 before move-in.

heading: Notice
text: Tenant must give 30 days written notice to end the lease.

heading: Repairs
text: The landlord is responsible for repairs. Report problems to the office.

heading: Late fee
text: A late fee of $45 applies after the grace period.

heading: Terms
text: Security deposit means money held to cover unpaid rent or damage.

heading: Required records
text: Tenant must provide proof of income by November 2, 2026.
